content.comment_body: Hello. I would like to know the minimum signal duration required for [product_name] [article_no] to register an input. Thank you.
I'm sorry, but I'm not sure I fully understand your question. Could you please explain it in a different way?

Based on the manual, standard digital inputs can handle frequencies up to 4 Hz. Basic modules operating with pure DC voltage have 4 fast counter inputs that support frequencies up to 5 kHz. These fast counter inputs aren't available in expansion modules. They can only be used if the input is directly linked to the counter or a frequency threshold trigger.
